name: The Sleeping Bear of the Red Land

steps.name: The Sleeping Bear of the Red Land (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Crisien] in "Mars", then find [Valdrick] in "Phobos".

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yawn... Hello, Adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look sleepy again today, Crisien. Yawn... I think your yawning is contagious.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to visit Phobos again.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Do you have any clothes you'd like repaired, or something you'd like me to make?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I don't.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: That's a shame, but it can't be helped... Yawn... Still, since you've come to see me, I can't let you leave just yet.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Have you seen Uncle Valdrick?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you need a favor involving Valdrick?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Wow, thank you for understanding!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: He's probably eaten an enormous meal and gone to sleep like a red bear. As if he's hibernating!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, is this a favor worth waking a sleeping bear for?!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Whoa, it's nothing serious. No need to be scared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's the sort of person who greets you with a lethal attack...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: There's a trick to it. Before you wake him, tell him Peonia has meat ready.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a rather primal approach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I gave him a few shirts, but they were ruined in no time. I've given up and just repair what he's wearing now and then.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: It's been a while since I last mended his clothes. Tell him to come to Mars for repairs.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Tell him I'll come out if he shouts, "Miss Designer!" outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miss Designer?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: It's embarrassing to say, but my dream is to become a famous fashion designer. I'm studying to make that happen.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: (Crisien's eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I've heard there are many designers like that in Freios. I'd love to visit if I get the chance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'll do well. Don't worry too much. When you make it, I'll be your customer.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Of course, dear customer...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: You've cheered me up, %s, so I'll go take a little nap.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yaaawn...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, now I'm sleepy too. Shall I go see Valdrick?

steps.name: The Sleeping Bear of the Red Land (2)
steps.objective: Defeat monsters in "Cradle of Illusions" and obtain <Cradle Flower>. Then report to [Valdrick] in "Phobos".

lines.text: (Valdrick sleeps sprawled comfortably in a quiet spot. Empty dishes surround him, suggesting he recently finished eating.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He really is a red bear preparing to hibernate... Should I wake him or not...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, like Crisien said... Valdrick, Peonia has meat...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Meat sounds good. It's roasted, right? Soup doesn't count.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It worked. He got right up.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Where's the meat?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Crisien said you'd wake up immediately if I said that.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Oh, well. She'll just have to treat me to a feast next time...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Since she sent you, I suppose Crisien wants me to call her "Miss Designer" outside Mars again?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Getting clothes repaired is a bother... But I can't keep wearing them in tatters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hanging heavy things from cloth probably doesn't help.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: True. But it can't be helped. I have to stay alive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay alive?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I may be called a Champion, but I'm still human at heart. I have to live. If I die, someone else will inherit this troublesome power.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: How could I die when I don't know what that person would do with it? It's mine, so I have to look after it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that like what Ziskad said...?)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Oh, hadn't I told you? You look completely lost. The others must not have explained.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I simply thought you'd received power from a god.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Really? Leaving old Atkina aside since he's a dragon, the humans—my little brother Ziskad, that brat Shynic, and the ladies Medea and Io...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: We're all living because we can't die. We missed our time to go. If we didn't find ways to live like this, we'd go mad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe that's why Yuran stopped Ull...)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Since the kid offered to mend my clothes, I'll have to visit sometime. She'll be happy if I call her "Miss Designer" like she wants, right?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I wonder if she's all right, though. I hope the village isn't shunning her because of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You care about Crisien.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Peonia and the kid both struggle to get by, yet they still feed me. How could I not be grateful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the food...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Nothing fills your stomach like meat. Funny how the kid likes clothes more than meat. Oh, that reminds me!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Little sibling, if you're bored, do me a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? I'm not bored...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Bring me lots of white flowers from the Cradle. They all look the same to me. If you gather them, maybe you'll find the right ones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Flowers?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yep. Now I'm going to sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'm going to sleep. You interrupted my nap. You heard from little brother Ziskad, didn't you? Think you could spar with me for three days and nights without a break?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just go get them.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: If I don't wake up, say "meat." Actual meat would be even better.
(The instant he finishes speaking, Valdrick lies down and falls asleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew. I'll hurry back and get something to eat. Meat, maybe?)

steps.name: The Sleeping Bear of the Red Land (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lilith] in "Cradle of Illusions" and obtain the <Succubus Velvet Dress>. Then report to [Crisien] in "Mars".

lines.text: (Valdrick sleeps curled up. Even asleep, he radiates a powerful presence.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He feels wilder than the other Champions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick, I'm back. Right, he said that wouldn't wake him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meat...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Did you bring flowers instead of meat?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick, what do you need these for?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: These flowers draw demonic energy out of objects. When my master first met me, she called me a devil and slapped me with them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't that a completely different example?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha! A devil like me turned out this well. Same difference.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's see♬ Master said to pull off all the petals and carry them with you. That's all it takes♬
(Valdrick places the petals in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you giving these to me...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Now, tuck them inside your clothes and go back into the Cradle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Find a dress that succubus Lilith left behind. I've heard high-ranking succubi bring spare clothes when they go out.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Lilith probably brought something quite luxurious. I'm sure you'll be able to find it again.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Once you find it, take it straight to Crisien instead of coming back to me. It'll help with her studies. Tell her it's in return for the meat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But it's a demon's dress. Is it really safe to give her?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Don't worry so much, little sibling. These are no ordinary flowers.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: When my master passed away, old Atkina brought them from Lapier to mourn her. They bloomed, withered, bloomed again, and spread...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Even after all this time, they work perfectly. Few people know that, though. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's reassuring.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I asked for your help, but I feel bad. It seems like I'm taking advantage of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. As long as it isn't sparring.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That hurts a little... Anyway, I'm counting on you. I'll get some more sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rest well, then. See you later.
(Watching %s head toward the Cradle of Illusions, Valdrick lies down on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What an interesting one.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Is it about time everyone arrived? I'll get up when they wake me.
(Crisien nods off while holding a piece of fabric.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Crisien still looks sleepy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Strange. When I first found it, it felt like a succubus's dress. Now, thanks to the petals, it almost feels sacred.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yaaawn... So sleepy. %s? Weren't you going to see Uncle Valdrick?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did. I have something for you.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: What is it...?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Ah!
(Crisien's perpetually sleepy eyes snap wide open.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: No way! This is...!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: What is this? The finest velvet, made using a technique said to have been passed down only in the long-fallen Kingdom of Howl!!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: An exquisite design that brings out the wearer's charm to the fullest!!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: And such a lovely rose fragrance! Incredibly elegant and beautiful...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: This didn't originally come from Eastland, did it? Something this wonderful suddenly appearing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, yes... It's difficult to explain exactly, but it's safe. I found it with the goddess's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick said it's in return for the meat.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Ah... The amount of meat that man has eaten...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just how much does he eat...?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hehe, I'm only saying. I'll gladly accept it. I was looking for a new outfit to study. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Thanks to you both, I'm a little closer to my dream.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer. There's something I wanted to ask. Have you ever met any female Champions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A few. Why?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I've heard they're wonderful. I'd like to give them my clothes and have them walk in a fashion show.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: The three of them have different figures and styles, so I'd like to design something for each of them. Hehe. One might be easier than the others.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Uncle Valdrick said she's a little brat like me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'll get in trouble if you say that to her face...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck, Crisien. I'll be cheering you on.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer! Come visit Mars often.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hehehe... Maybe I'll have Peo try it on first. Everything suits her.
